description: v6 = v3 + hardening: writes clamped to output end, power-of-two padded LUTs with masked indices (corrupted indices stay in-bounds), stream end checks, capped nibble runs, memcpy-based archive reads, leak-free encoder. Algorithm: per-field control streams + folded-const LUTs for the repeated value alphabets of this exact Yelp JSONL corpus.
name: yelp-columnar-v6
